message.content: {"decision":"accept","reason":"This GitHub blog post introduces the concept of replacing chat-based AI interaction with customizable 'canvases' in the GitHub Copilot app, showing a concrete new UI approach that learners can try to better delegate tasks to coding agents. It provides first-hand examples like a Connect 4 game and SQLite package manager, illustrating how learners can automate workflows beyond chat, which directly affects what beginners can delegate and how they interact with agents.
